0:
ops=(
  "db:add-missing-primary-keys"
  "db:add-missing-indices"
  "db:add-missing-columns"
  "files:cleanup"
)
grey="\e[1;30m"
reset="\e[0m"
green="\e[1;32m"
red="\e[1;31m"
for op in "$${ops[@]}" ; do
  echo -e "$${grey}Running php occ $op $reset"
  su www-data -s /usr/local/bin/php -- occ $op && echo -en "$green" || echo -en "$red"
  echo -e "Finished php occ $op $reset"
done &&
echo -e "$${grey}Running php occ maintenance:repair --include-expensive $reset"
su www-data -s /usr/local/bin/php -- occ maintenance:repair --include-expensive && echo -en "$green" || echo -en "$red"
echo -e "Finished php occ maintenance:repair --include-expensive $reset"
while :; do /cron.sh; done

chmod +x /var/www/html/custom_apps/notify_push/bin/x86_64/notify_push && \
while :; do su www-data \
  -s /var/www/html/custom_apps/notify_push/bin/x86_64/notify_push -- \
  /var/www/html/config/config.php; sleep 1; done &
pid=$!
grey="\e[1;30m"
reset="\e[0m"
green="\e[1;32m"
red="\e[1;31m"
echo -e "$${grey}Waiting a few seconds for services to start$${reset}"
sleep 10
echo -e "$${grey}Testing if push app is configured"
op="notify_push:setup https://${social_domain}/push"
while ! su www-data -s /usr/local/bin/php -- occ "notify_push:self-test"; do
  echo -e "$${grey}Self-test failed, running php occ $op $reset"
  if ! su www-data -s /usr/local/bin/php -- occ $op; then
    echo -e "$${red}$${op} operation failed, retrying...$${reset}"
    sleep 5
  fi
done
echo -e "$${green}Test passed$${reset}"
wait $pid

mkdir -p /home/nonroot/.claude
[ -f /home/nonroot/.claude/settings.json ] || cp /home/nonroot/config/claude-settings.json /home/nonroot/.claude/settings.json
[ -f /home/nonroot/.claude/CLAUDE.md ] || cp /home/nonroot/config/CLAUDE.md /home/nonroot/.claude/CLAUDE.md
claude mcp remove -s user victoriametrics 2>/dev/null
claude mcp remove -s user chrome-devtools 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add -s user --transport http victoriametrics http://mcp-victoriametrics.victoria-metrics.svc.cluster.local:8080/mcp
claude mcp add -s user --transport http chrome-devtools http://127.0.0.1:9223/mcp

while true; do
  rm -rf /tmp/chrome
  chromium-browser --headless --remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir=/tmp/chrome
  sleep 1
done

set -eu
mc alias set local http://minio:9000 "$MINIO_ROOT_USER" "$MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD"
mc mb --ignore-existing local/dossier
# s3:ListBucket is not for listing: the app's boot-time
# BucketExists probe is a HeadBucket, which minio authorizes as
# s3:ListBucket. Without it the app fails to start.
cat > /tmp/dossier-rw.json <<'JSON'
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetBucketLocation", "s3:ListBucket"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::dossier"]
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "s3:GetObject",
        "s3:PutObject",
        "s3:DeleteObject",
        "s3:AbortMultipartUpload",
        "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts"
      ],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::dossier/*"]
    }
  ]
}
JSON
mc admin policy create local dossier-rw /tmp/dossier-rw.json
mc admin user add local "$DOSSIER_S3_ACCESS_KEY" "$DOSSIER_S3_SECRET_KEY"
# attach is not idempotent: it errors once the policy is on the user
mc admin user info local "$DOSSIER_S3_ACCESS_KEY" | grep -q dossier-rw ||
  mc admin policy attach local dossier-rw --user "$DOSSIER_S3_ACCESS_KEY"
